description: This file contains utility functions for the 'opik' integration, including configuration management, UUID generation, and payload processing.

methods.name: create_uuid7
methods.description: Generates a UUID version 7 based on current time and random bytes.

methods.name: _read_opik_config_file
methods.description: Reads the 'opik' section from the default configuration file.

methods.name: _get_env_variable
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable with 'opik_' prefix.

methods.name: get_opik_config_variable
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration variable with priority: user input, environment, config file, default.

methods.name: create_usage_object
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with usage tokens if they are not None.

methods.name: _remove_nulls
methods.description: Removes keys with None values from a dictionary.

methods.name: get_traces_and_spans_from_payload
methods.description: Separates payload into traces and spans based on presence of 'type' key.
